Heavy Rains Cause Severe Waterlogging and Traffic Jams in Delhi-NCR

Heavy monsoon rains have caused widespread waterlogging and damaged roads across Delhi and the National Capital Region (NCR). The deluge has led to significant traffic congestion, with vehicles getting stuck and damaged. News reports highlight submerged streets resembling seas and disruptions to daily commutes, though some children were seen enjoying the unusual conditions.
